settings.heading: Unsubscribe from OLNIAN emails
settings.body:
Fastest: click "Unsubscribe" at the bottom of any OLNIAN email. It takes effect immediately.

Or enter your email below and we will remove you from our marketing list within 2 business days.
settings.success_message: Request received. We will remove you from our marketing emails within 2 business days. Order and shipping emails will still reach you.
settings.already_unsubscribed_message: You are signed in and already unsubscribed from our marketing emails. Nothing else to do.
settings.note: Unsubscribing stops marketing emails only. You will still get emails about your orders and active subscription.
